visualCharacteristics.purpose: featured article or case study intro with image beside breadcrumb, title and byline
visualCharacteristics.description: Fixed two-column layout: image beside breadcrumb, H2 and byline.

contentPattern.structure: one row with two cells: (1) image; (2) breadcrumb paragraph of links, heading, author paragraph, date / read-time paragraph
rows: Column 2: breadcrumb links (Home, Case studies), H2, byline 'By Taylor Brooks', 'June 12, 2024 • 4 min read'

usage: Intro of a featured story or case study.
reuseGuidance: The first all-link paragraph before the heading becomes a breadcrumb nav; paragraphs after the heading are styled as byline/meta.
